packageRules.description: The oldest Paper the plugins support. Raising it drops every server still on it, so it's changed by hand. The newest Paper is tracked by .github/workflows/minecraft.yml.
Third-party actions run with the repo's secrets, so they're pinned to a commit (CodeQL flags tags, which can be moved); Renovate keeps the pins current. GitHub's own actions stay on tags.
CI builds, tests and boots every plugin, and merging releases nothing, so small updates merge themselves once it passes. Majors wait for a review.
